name: project_git_status
description: Read the configured Unity repository, current branch, exact HEAD and local file changes. Use before starting or resuming a ContinueWork task.

name: project_git_diff
description: Read the combined staged and unstaged diff of tracked files against HEAD in the configured Unity project. The returned diff can be truncated.

files.description: Optional exact project-relative paths, using forward slashes.

name: project_git_prepare
description: Fetch origin and prepare the requested feature branch in the open Unity checkout. New branches start at the configured base branch. Existing branches only fast-forward when possible.

branch.description: Exact feature branch agreed in the GitHub issue.

name: project_git_commit
description: Commit explicitly selected local Unity project files on the expected feature branch and HEAD after saving and testing in Unity. Include changed .meta companions where applicable.

files.description: Exact project-relative changed files, not folders.

name: project_git_push
description: Push exactly the tested commit from the clean local Unity checkout to the matching feature branch on the configured origin. Git rejects non-fast-forward pushes.

expectedHead.description: Exact tested commit SHA to publish.
